title: Connect liquid interactions to production fixed ticks
requires: Production runtime/toolchain plus applicable physical GPU; cross-platform build evidence
scope: Bind F8-18 and existing liquid interaction operators to native public graphs: liquid/liquid and liquid with rigid, cloth, soft-body, rope or smoke, limited to currently implemented modes. Boundary phase transfer is completed in F8-48. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-SINGLE-EXECUTION-PATH.md.
acceptance: Every already supported liquid interaction tuple executes its real production pressure, viscosity, contact, containment, drag or thermal operator as applicable, with canonical capability-derived coverage.
Use four coupling sweeps, one shared neighbor/spatial epoch and single endpoint commits; check independent conservation/dissipation/containment and three-family oracles on an applicable physical GPU.
Multi-population graphs, unequal material inputs where already supported, graph rollback and capacity recovery retain deterministic identities without repeated neighbor builds.
Do not advertise unfinished P-series interactions, remove existing supported GPU capabilities to pass, or substitute CPU/private-kernel execution for public GPU evidence.
